desc: Alegre y triste (happy & sad) is a Regional Mexican MARIACHI album featuring the lead vocals of Danny Osuna and Rain Bisou accompanied by violins, trumpets, Spanish guitar, vihuela (acoustic convex back guitar) and guitarrón (acoustic bass guitar).

tracks.desc: This celebratory Regional Mexican song describes a night-time musical event in the open air, a traditional block party where national colors flow and the smell of sugar cane accompanies many toasts of tequila, lime and salt. Features a signature arpeggiated riff played by a jarana - a Mexican 8 stringed folk guitar with two single outer strings surrounding three double pairs - played with very percussive accented down and double upstroke pattern that mimics the "zapateado" steps of the dancers.

Literally translates to "from the sea to the land". Quintessential Regional Mexican travel song with themes of exploration, foreign lands, lush castles and gardens, where discovery of the most far-reaching corners is a thrill. Features the distinct sound of a wooden marimba along with a Mariachi guitarrón (Mexican acoustic bass guitar), guitars, trumpets and violins. Perfect for travel documentaries, cooking shows and lifestyle television.

Literally translates to "happy and sad". This mid-tempo Regional Mexican song in 3/4 time features the heartfelt and powerful vocals of Rain Bisou (Rina Guadalupe Cervantes). Describes the complex, often contradictory mixed emotions of true love, where one can feel the lonely sadness of being abandoned, and at the same time a tinge of happy relief that one's tired lover has actually left. Includes a Mariachi guitarrón, guitars, trumpets and violins. Perfect for dramas and soap operas.

A tender, melancholic Regional Mexican song about the longing and hopeful return of lost love. Expresses themes of romance, heartache, yearning and not wanting to let go of desire. Features a Mariachi guitarrón, guitars, trumpets and violins. Perfect for relationship and romantic dramas, soap operas and melodramatic scenes.

Literally translates to "dark memories". This moody Regional Mexican ballad features the powerful and passionate vocals of Rain Bisou (Rina Guadalupe Cervantes). Vibes and themes of loneliness, heartache, sorrow, lost love, sadness, and darkness. Includes a Mariachi guitarrón, guitars, trumpets and violins. Perfect for dramas and soap operas.
